text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

To get the facts straight first: I've paid every month's rent for my flat at Seestrasse 21 in Luzern, CHF 1280, directly to Erlenhof Trading Ltd as usual, including August, September and October. Not a single payment has gone into a deposit account with any authority.

Now to the reason I'm writing. On 8 August 2026 a cocktail bar opened in the ground-floor premises of our building, which belong to the same landlord. Since then, from Thursday to Saturday, there is loud bass music until well after two in the morning, and the guests stand smoking and shouting directly under my bedroom window until three or four. The vibration from the speakers comes up through the floor; on bad nights my water glass on the bedside table rattles. I've measured the noise with a phone app at over 60 decibels in my bedroom with the windows closed.

I work early shifts at the hospital and have to get up at five. Since August I have barely slept properly on weekends, I've started sleeping on a mattress in the kitchen at the back of the flat, and my friend Ian Bieri has let me stay at his place a few times just to get some rest. I rented this flat in 2022 because it was quiet. I'm paying for a home I can't sleep in.

What can I do to get my landlord to deal with this?

Yours faithfully,
Jack Zaugg
